symptom: full worktree checkout exhausted persistent-disk inode quota
correction: recreated a sparse independent worktree containing source/config/contracts/tests and required authority output

symptom: Night13B MISAR loader could not see the registered Night8B mapping in sparse checkout
correction: added the exact committed outputs/night8b_handoff path to sparse checkout and reran all seven kit datasets

symptom: AST inspection parsed an indented class source fragment
correction: applied textwrap.dedent before ast.parse and reran the complete targeted test file

symptom: top teacher partitions could repeat one representation/head across seeds
correction: required structural diversity by selecting at most one partition per embedding before SAPR anchor construction

symptom: computing Moran and Geary for every discarded refinement dominated local CPU time
correction: kept ARI/NMI/AMI/FMI for all rows and recomputed Moran/Geary only for retained finalist and aggregate partitions

symptom: author-supplied 3d-OT embeddings were available to the own-method P22 search
correction: kept them in the kit for protocol replay but excluded every 3DOT_CONTEXT embedding from own candidate generation

symptom: the first valid internal-only P22 grid spent over 40 minutes before completing one dataset
correction: limited each embedding to seven mechanism-distinct transforms and skipped tied-GMM when N exceeded 5000 while retaining KMeans and diagonal-GMM

symptom: majority consensus could erase a small cluster even though every teacher had K clusters
correction: restored missing cardinality deterministically from the medoid cluster member with largest vote advantage and reran both family P0 lanes

symptom: fine-search slots were still consumed by multiple coarse heads of the same embedding so most lanes produced fewer than three structurally distinct SAPR teachers
correction: deduplicated coarse finalists by embedding identity before fine search and reran every head-HPO lane

symptom: the retained-teacher ablation was evaluated after model-adapter standardization although its endpoint had been frozen on the original retained embedding
correction: kept standardized input only inside SAPR and evaluated the retained control on the exact frozen embedding then invalidated and reran both-family P0
affected_lane_rerun: A1 and P22 P0 plus all SAPR formal lanes

symptom: successive P0 screen finalist and confirmation invocations would overwrite resource audit provenance and omit phase from the run ledger
correction: loaded and appended the prior audit and registered experiment_phase on every row before formal screening

symptom: the SAPR evaluator used GMM n_init 3 and 300 iterations while the frozen head search used n_init 1 and 120 so even the exact retained embedding did not replay its registered partition
correction: matched the GMM fit parameters to the frozen local runner and invalidated both-family P0 again
affected_lane_rerun: A1 and P22 P0 plus all SAPR formal lanes

symptom: the P0 phase wrote a zero-byte main ledger because its six rows belong only to the P0 audit and the subsequent screen could not parse it
correction: guarded empty-ledger reads and writes then restarted the complete screen before any formal row was produced
